messages:
lucy: Quick heads-up 1: Helix SI onboarding for marketplace + hw vouchers. Need final training schedule and the public playbook by the end of next week. Also need HW voucher redemption flow for partner trials. Who picks this up?
raj: I can own voucher flow. Is there an existing redemption API or do we need to add one?
oliver: There's a small endpoint already: POST /api/v1/partners/vouchers/redeem payload { code, user_email }. I'll paste a sample curl in the docs. Will open a PR with example by tomorrow.
tia: I'll lead the training curriculum. Thinking: 2 instructor-led sessions (deploy & ops), 1 lab day, plus a self-paced lab with automated checks. Proposed dates May 10, May 17, May 24. Need 3x A100-sandboxes for the lab day. @marc can you allocate?
marc: Confirmed 3 A100 sandboxes reserved for May 24. Also provisioning 5 small dev GPUs for pre-work. Send me partner account emails and tenant IDs.
lucy: For marketplace listing we need partner short blurb, logos, security attestation, and at least one integration tutorial. I'll draft the blurb. Can someone produce a screenshot of the model routing UI?
oliver: Will grab a screenshot. Quick CLI sample to spin a test target: ```
rwdctl model start --model redwood/opt-13b --region us-west-2 --size a100
```
tia: Certification suggestion: "Helix Integrator" and "Helix Architect" tracks. Exam format: 25 multiple-choice + 5 practical labs, 90min total. Badges: digital PNG + verification token. Any objections?
raj: Legal okay with minimal telemetry for cert verification: partner_id, badge_id, pass_timestamp. No user PII. I'll confirm in writing.
lucy: Also want a private internal runbook (onboarding checklist, escalation contacts) and a public partner guide (how to get started). Need both by Friday COB.
marc: I'll create a shared Confluence space and export the public guide as PDF. Draft up Wednesday, final Friday.
tia: Labs will include 4 checkpoints: deploy demo app -> validate routing -> perform load test -> cost tuning. Each has acceptance checks with CLI commands.
oliver: Add a troubleshooting note: common fail is missing KMS alias or partner role not attached. Example command: `aws kms create-alias --target-key-id <key-id> --alias-name alias/helix-partner`
lucy: Action items: Raj -> voucher redemption endpoint docs + curl sample; Tia -> training + cert blueprint; Marc -> sandbox allocation + Confluence page; Oliver -> CLI snippets + screenshots. I'll schedule a 20m check-in Fri 9am PT and drop calendar invite.
raj: Sounds good :white_check_mark:
marc: on it :rocket:
tia: thanks team :raised_hands:
